answer_1.quote: KG-to-text generation, automatically converting knowledge into comprehensive natural language, is an important task in natural language processing (NLP) and user interaction studies.
answer_1.outputs: natural language text describing the input knowledge

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we use several common evaluation metrics: BLEU, METEOR, TER, ROUGE 1, ROUGE 2, ROUGE L, PARENT.

answer_4.quote: We hire 6 annotators to evaluate the quality based on three evaluation metrics: fluency, grammar and authenticity.
answer_4.guideline: We give our annotators all main entities' neighbors, 1-hop and 2-hop connections between main entities and topic-related entities as references. A full score will be given if the statements in the generated sentences are consistent with the facts shown in the KG.
